id: title:Gilbert09:avoid sigpipe aborting the golden setup script

review.posthog_relevance: Build and deployment reliability for Hogland (backend task execution environment)
review.reason: The change replaces piped commands with variable assignments and conditional checks, adding comments. This prevents SIGPIPE-related failures during the setup of the Hogland golden image, potentially improving the reliability of the build process. This is a narrow, localised maintenance improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is potential; no runtime behavior or test results are shown. The relationship between the two hunks is not established, though they share the same file and purpose.
